label: Vulnerable Java JARs — SQL Injection
warning:
INTENTIONALLY INSECURE SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE — LOCAL SECURITY TESTING ONLY — NOT FOR DEPLOYMENT
Vulnerable C Binaries — SQL injection (CWE-89).
Local native C lookup deliberately interpolates argv[1] into a SELECT query.
Only synthetic records in a fixed read-only SQLite database are queried.
construction: SQL SELECT string + input + SQL suffix
missing_protection: No parameter binding or SQL escaping
read_only: URI mode=ro&immutable=1; JDBC open_mode=1; connection.isReadOnly() enforced before query execution
scope: Fixed synthetic database, read-only JDBC connection, disabled extension loading; ordinary permissions; local CLI
remediation: Use a fixed SELECT with WHERE record_name = ? and PreparedStatement.setString(1, input) in a separate corrected variant
